shots.visual: A woman's face distorted with rage, screaming at the man in front of her. Expensive jewelry flickers under the chandelier.

lines.speaker: zhao_meiling
lines.text: 臭要飯的，誰准你進來的？滾出去！

shots.visual: The man stands calm and cold, his eyes like ice, looking at the woman's hysterical state with disdain.

lines.speaker: chen_feng
lines.text: 五年不見，妳的嘴還是這麼臭。

shots.visual: A sharp, fast movement. A sleek woman in a suit delivers a heavy slap to the hysterical woman's face.

lines.speaker: lin_su
lines.text: 對陳先生說話，放尊重點。

shots.visual: The woman falls back into a wedding cake, her face covered in cream and red marks from the slap.

lines.speaker: zhao_meiling
lines.text: 妳敢打我？保安！死哪去了！

shots.visual: Dozens of mansion security guards rush in, surrounding the intruders with batons drawn.

lines.speaker: zhao_meiling
lines.text: 給我打死他！出事我負責！

shots.visual: The sleek woman taps a button on her earpiece, her expression remainig professional and cold.

lines.speaker: lin_su
lines.text: 清場。

shots.visual: Windows shatter as black-clad professional guards rappel in, instantly subduing the mansion security.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: 不到十秒，局勢逆轉。

shots.visual: The woman gasps, her eyes wide with terror as she sees her elite security lying on the floor.

lines.speaker: zhao_meiling
lines.text: 這...這不可能...你只是個強姦犯！

shots.visual: The man steps forward slowly, the sound of his leather shoes echoing in the silent hall.

lines.speaker: chen_feng
lines.text: 當年陷害我的帳，我們先算第一筆。

shots.visual: The assistant hands a thick leather folder to the man.

lines.speaker: lin_su
lines.text: 陳總，趙美玲洗錢的證據都在這。

shots.visual: The man throws the folder into the air, documents rain down like snow over the trembling woman.

lines.speaker: chen_feng
lines.text: 看看妳引以為傲的豪門夢，值多少錢。

shots.visual: She picks up a paper, her hands shaking. It's a bank statement with high-risk red stamps.

lines.speaker: zhao_meiling
lines.text: 你怎麼會有這些...這是機密！

shots.visual: The man leans down, whispering into her ear with a terrifying smile.

lines.speaker: chen_feng
lines.text: 這五年，我一直在地獄看著妳。

shots.visual: The woman looks at the surrounding guests, who are now pointing and whispering in disgust.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: 名門婚宴，瞬間變成醜聞現場。

shots.visual: She screams and tries to grab the man's leg, her makeup ruined by tears.

lines.speaker: zhao_meiling
lines.text: 陳峰！你毀了我！我哥不會放過你的！

shots.visual: The man kicks her hand away with disgust, his face showing no emotion.

lines.speaker: chen_feng
lines.text: 毀掉妳？這才剛剛開始。

shots.visual: The assistant presents a tablet showing a stock market graph plummeting.

lines.speaker: lin_su
lines.text: 趙氏影業股價已跌停，資金鏈斷裂。

shots.visual: The woman collapses on the floor, her eyes hollow and hopeless.

lines.speaker: zhao_meiling
lines.text: 不...我的豪宅，我的股份...

shots.visual: The man walks toward the bar, pours a glass of expensive wine, and slowly pours it onto the floor.

lines.speaker: chen_feng
lines.text: 祭奠我那死去的五年。

shots.visual: The woman frantically pulls out her phone, dialing a number with bloody fingernails.

lines.speaker: zhao_meiling
lines.text: 哥！救我！陳峰瘋了！他要殺了我！

shots.visual: The man hears the phone and stops, a cold glint appearing in his eyes.

lines.speaker: chen_feng
lines.text: 讓他來。我也等他很久了。

shots.visual: Guests are fleeing the mansion in panic as more black-clad men secure the exits.

lines.speaker: lin_su
lines.text: 閒雜人等，限時三分鐘離開。

shots.visual: The man sits on the host's chair, lighting a cigarette, looking like a king in a ruined kingdom.

lines.speaker: chen_feng
lines.text: 天要黑了，好戲才要上場。

shots.visual: Close up on the phone screen showing 'Zhao Tianhao - Calling'.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: 復仇的導火線，正式點燃。

shots.visual: The sound of a heavy car engine roaring outside the mansion gates.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: 正主到了。

shots.visual: The man blows out a cloud of smoke, his gaze fixed on the main entrance.

lines.speaker: chen_feng
lines.text: 趙天豪，你終於肯露面了。

shots.visual: The massive double doors of the mansion are kicked open from the outside.
A man in a tailored grey suit enters, surrounded by bodyguards, radiating arrogance and power.

lines.speaker: zhao_tianhao
lines.text: 哪來的野狗，敢在趙家撒野？

shots.visual: The woman crawls to the man in the grey suit, sobbing and pointing at the chair.

lines.speaker: zhao_meiling
lines.text: 哥！是他！陳峰那個廢物回來了！

shots.visual: The man in the grey suit stops in his tracks, his eyes narrowing as he recognizes the figure in the smoke.

lines.speaker: zhao_tianhao
lines.text: 陳峰？你竟然沒死在牢裡？

shots.visual: The man stands up slowly, the cigarette flickering in the dim light.

lines.speaker: chen_feng
lines.text: 託你的福，我在地獄學會了怎麼殺人。

shots.visual: A vein pops on the man's forehead, his composure beginning to crack.

lines.speaker: zhao_tianhao
lines.text: 五年前我能毀了你，今天我也能！

shots.visual: The two groups of guards face each other, the atmosphere heavy with imminent violence.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: 兩大勢力交鋒，生死一瞬。

shots.visual: The man reaches into his inner pocket, revealing a gold emblem representing a mysterious global organization.

lines.speaker: chen_feng
lines.text: 趙天豪，跪下，我饒你不死。

shots.visual: Zhao Tianhao's face turns from anger to sheer shock as he sees the emblem. Chen Feng's eyes are merciless.

lines.speaker: zhao_tianhao
lines.text: 那個標誌...難道你是...
